title: Astrocyte Morphology Assessment in Astrocyte-Neuron Co-Cultures
author: Shiyi Wang
materials: Incubate samples Overnight at 4 °C in primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer containing 10% NGS. Validate antibody specificity and optimize staining conditions for reproducibility.

steps.title: Fix cultures with 4% PFA
steps.instruction: Fix astrocyte‑neuron co‑cultures on glass coverslips at DIV 12 by incubating in warm 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) for 7 minutes (00:07:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash coverslips three times
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed coverslips three times with DPBS.

steps.title: Block coverslips with serum/Triton
steps.instruction: Incubate coverslips in blocking buffer containing 50 % normal goat serum (NGS) and 0.4 % Triton X‑100 for 30 minutes (00:30:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Remove primary antibody, wash DPBS
steps.instruction: Remove primary antibody solution and wash the coverslips three times with DPBS.

steps.title: Incubate with Alexa Fluor secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Incubate coverslips in Alexa Fluor‑conjugated secondary antibodies for 2 hours (02:00:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Remove secondary antibody, wash DPBS
steps.instruction: Remove secondary antibody solution and wash the coverslips three times with DPBS.

steps.title: Additional wash coverslips three times
steps.instruction: Wash coverslips three times with DPBS (as a separate wash step).

steps.title: Mount coverslips with Vectashield DAPI
steps.instruction: Mount coverslips onto glass slides using Vectashield mounting medium that contains DAPI.

steps.title: Seal coverslips with nail polish
steps.instruction: Seal the mounted coverslips with nail polish.

steps.title: Image coverslips with Keyence microscope
steps.instruction: Image the coverslips on a Keyence BZ‑X800 microscope at 40× magnification, acquiring red, green, and/or DAPI channels with a CCD camera.

steps.title: Analyze morphology using FIJI Sholl
steps.instruction: Analyze astrocyte morphological complexity in FIJI using the Sholl analysis plugin (https://github.com/Eroglu-Lab/In-Vitro-Sholl). Perform analysis only on healthy astrocytes that show strong fluorescent marker expression and have single, non‑overlapping DAPI‑stained nuclei.

steps.title: Perform statistical analysis in R
steps.instruction: Conduct statistical analyses with the custom R code provided (https://github.com/Eroglu-Lab/In-Vitro-Sholl).

steps.title: Apply mixed‑effect model with Tukey test
steps.instruction: Use a mixed‑effect model with a Tukey post‑test for the Sholl analysis, treating variability per experiment as a random effect.

steps.title: Verify astrocyte health criteria
steps.instruction: Confirm culture health by ensuring the peak number of astrocyte intersections is ≥ 25 in the control condition.

steps.title: Document experiment numbers in legend
steps.instruction: Record the exact number of independent experiments and cells analyzed in the figure legend for each experiment.
